news.title: SUFFOC at the Compass Sport Final
news.text: 26 members travelled to East Sussex for the 2026 Compass Sport Trophy final. It is only the fifth time the club has qualified.

news.title: SUFFOC 2026 AGM
news.text: The AGM came with a short score event in Christchurch Park beforehand, and a promise that nobody would be forced into a role.
